name: 92111 · San Diego, CA
findings: ZIP 92111 (San Diego) has 254 nonprofit organizations. 127 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 108 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92111 (San Diego) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92111 (San Diego) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).
